desc: Read N and edges, build adjacency list.
Perform iterative DFS from root=1 to obtain parent array and processing order.
Initialize arrays best_up (size N+1) and deep_up (size N+1, fill with -1).

Process nodes in reverse order: for each node v, collect best_up of children, compute deep_up[v] if at least 3 children (use 3 largest), compute best_up[v] = max(1, deep_up[v]), compute root1[v] if any child has deep_up, compute root4[v] if at least 4 children.
Maintain a global answer variable as the max of all root1[v] and root4[v]; if none, answer stays -1.
Test on provided sample inputs and edge cases (chain, star, small N).
